summary: An OpenAI employee states that the company temporarily slowed some frontier training and put its largest planned frontier RL run on hold to strengthen security and monitoring while running smaller-scale training and evaluations.

mechanisms.reason: A named frontier RL training run is explicitly paused, reducing near-term training compute demand.
mechanisms.quote: Our largest planned frontier RL run remains on hold while smaller-scale training and evaluations help us test safeguards and gather more evidence of alignment.

practices.reason: The post mentions running evaluations to test safeguards but gives no method or transferable technique.
practices.quote: smaller-scale training and evaluations help us test safeguards and gather more evidence of alignment

notable_reason: A frontier lab publicly disclosing that it has paused its largest planned training run for safety reasons is an unusual, concrete signal about compute allocation and internal safety posture.
